B) Offer technical workshop + limited credits (low-friction)

We can definitely scope a 2-week non-prod POC. Minimal footprint to validate latency: 2 x A100-equivalent instances (or 4 x lower-tier GPUs with kernel optimizations) depending on sequence length and batch profile. Key asks from our side:
- Sample workload: a 30-minute trace or representative payloads (anonymized) to reproduce peak bursts
- Success criteria: p95 latency < 2s and cost-per-1k tokens target (we can align with pricing sheet)

I can prepare a demo env template and a one-page test plan by EOD tomorrow. On the messaging side, highlight that the POC is non-prod, SOC 2 artifacts are available, and we can do a joint call to review results.

Also: caching and batching will materially reduce cost for their workload — we should call that out as a differentiated lever.
